name: Nika Pharmaceuticals Inc.
summary: Nika Pharmaceuticals Inc., a pharmaceutical enterprise headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, focuses on the creation of medications to address a broad spectrum of health conditions. Its research and development efforts target serious diseases including HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B and C, rheumatoid arthritis, cancer, and diabetes. The company's product line features antiviral treatments and nutritional supplements, notably providing a specialized thymus nuclear glycoprotein for the management of HIV. Originally established in 2000, the organization was previously known as Centennial Growth Equities Inc. before adopting its current name, Nika Pharmaceuticals, Inc., in May 2022.
